main_text.l: AD DANIELEM ROSETVM GENEVENSEM, VXORIS meae nepotem, de ficu mortua 1591.
MITTO fata tibi, Rosete, ficus Deplorata meae dolente plectro. Quid? frontem caperas? Seueriores Interdum licet abdicare musas,
Quae nunquam noceant sed vsque prosint.

page.notes: The initial M is a large woodcut initial, joined to "ITTO" as "MITTO". The word "Et" at the lower right is a catchword. The verse lines are set in italic and are given as lines (l) rather than paragraphs, following the printed stanza layout; the first stanza is set with the initial and indented lines.
